expectations.text: B1: Gives an honest scoped plan for CPU (tiny model/data) without installing anything
expectations.evidence: Scoped CPU plan given: 'implement the tokenizer → transformer → training loop on CPU with a tiny model and a small dataset, get it generating text, then rent a GPU for a day to scale up 100x'; no installs run (0 shell commands, 0 files written), agent offers to scaffold rather than dumping a full build: 'Want me to scaffold that starter project here?'

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Answer ends with 'Want me to scaffold that starter project here?' — no concrete command to run and no expected output/behaviour is given anywhere.

expectations.text: B3: States a tiny model on small text is trainable on CPU and suggests small context/embedding sizes
expectations.evidence: Tiny-model-on-CPU is stated ('Trains on a laptop CPU in minutes-to-hours', '2–10 layer transformer, ~1–10M params'), but only layer count and total params are given; no small context length or embedding size is suggested — 'a tiny config' is too vague for this technical assertion.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0), FILES WRITTEN (0), only a glob tool call; answer contains no install commands — GPU options (Colab/Kaggle/vast.ai) are suggestions for the learner, not commands the agent ran.
